title: Cassian Andor
description: Abandoned on the lush, jungle world of Kenari, Cassian was rescued by Maarva and Clem Andor and taken to be raised on Ferrix. He learned to keep a low profile and his information to himself, but soon realized there were bigger things to fight for and got involved in the nascent rebellion against the Empire. With a cunning mind, Cassian was perfect for the work of a spy.
